figures.name: NO_TFT_IMPLEMENTATION
figures.reason: The benchmark has not been run, and cannot be run in this repository today, for two independent reasons. There is no TFT implementation in the dependency set, and no environment here has ingested data, so the served arm has no training rows either.

figures.name: NOT_RUN_YET
figures.figure: the DESSEM A/B's three arms, and the floor advantage between them
figures.reason: The three runs have not been scored. This is not a floor advantage of zero and not a finding that DESSEM's features are worth nothing: the arms exist and their data exists, so this comparison is unmade rather than made and found uninteresting.

figures.name: no_joint_ensemble
figures.figure: the national day band - a P10, P50 and P90 over all four subsystems
figures.reason: A quantile of a sum is not the sum of the quantiles, and neither is a median: four subsystems' curtailment is not comonotone, so a national band can only be read off draws that were taken jointly. Where none was published the band is withheld and never filled by adding the four.

figures.name: COMPARABILITY["pr_auc"]
figures.figure: pr_auc, read across the sweep's three threshold arms
figures.caveat: not comparable across thresholds without its floor. PR-AUC's baseline is the prevalence, and the prevalence is exactly what the sweep moves; each arm's own prevalence is published beside it and the two are read together or not at all.
figures.misreading: that the arm with the higher PR-AUC ranks curtailment better

figures.name: COVERAGE_P10_OVER_NO_STATED_ROW
figures.figure: coverage_p10, on a fold where `coverage_stated_rows_p10` is zero
figures.caveat: coverage_p10 is 1.0 here and it is not a floor that held. No scored hour on this fold has a composed P10 that is a positive number, so every one of these evaluations is y >= 0 on an hour known to be above tau.
figures.misreading: that the served floor held on every curtailed hour of this fold

figures.name: _NOT_A_READING
figures.figure: the lead-time A/B's three interval deltas and its delta qloss_mwh
figures.caveat: THESE DELTAS ARE NOT A MEASUREMENT OF THE GRID. The columns were built from fabricated metrics rows, so every coverage and MWh figure here is arithmetic over invented forecasts.
figures.misreading: that training on the stitched weather archive costs the served interval this much on the Brazilian grid
